static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.occupation: Not yet employed for the time being
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with friends, limited social support (has a few close friends but has not yet fully shared)
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problem history before, has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Prominent negative self-label ('I am a monster'), expression clear and coherent, able to work with the counselor and willing to try small steps, but overall attitude tends toward pessimism

basic_info.main_problem: Unable to visit the hospitalized mother often due to financial and other real-life constraints, persistently labeling oneself a 'monster', with worsening guilt and stress, affecting interpersonal relationships and self-care.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to reduce negative emotions and the 'I am a monster' self-label through counseling, in order to restore coping ability and mental health.

special_situations.event: Mother hospitalized, but financial difficulties prevent frequent visits
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot always be there to meet mother's needs, it shows I am an incompetent, disgusting person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Calling every day, communicating with the nurse, sending items within one's means to make up for it, but still engaging in persistent self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made her feel abandoned; I am a monster

special_situations.event: Mother verbally expresses understanding and comfort
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless I can visit regularly and fully meet her needs, any understanding does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring others' positive feedback, continuing to focus on one's own shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Her understanding is useless; I am still terrible

special_situations.event: Feeling that friends do not understand one after exchanging support with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends cannot fully understand my situation, it shows I am disgusting and unacceptable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing of true feelings, avoiding deeper help-seeking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand me; who would understand me then

special_situations.event: Recalling the caring actions done for mother (daily calls, communicating with the nurse, sending items)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve perfect companionship and financial support, it equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing only on what has not yet been achieved, ignoring the efforts already made
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: None of this is enough; I am still a monster

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be a dutiful, recognized good daughter and stay close to mother and care for her
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being seen as unfilial or a terrible person; fear that mother feels abandoned and hurt because of me
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of morality and control through self-blame
Avoids deep sharing to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.object_representation: An understanding but fragile mother who needs care

object_relations.linking_affect: Loneliness, the sense of frustration at being misunderstood

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores sharing feelings with friends or obtaining support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to think others will not understand or will judge one (projecting inner self-criticism onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Validate the worries in a gentle empathic tone, invite concretization of others' real feedback and evidence, avoid direct refutation, and encourage small steps toward more open sharing.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes behavioral experiments in small steps or restructuring beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Emphasizes real limitations and doubts about the effects of trying, to reduce the possibility of disappointment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First acknowledges real limitations and pressure, in a supportive tone jointly sets micro-goals, returns to observable evidence and experience, reducing defensive arguing.

manifestations: Finds it hard to fully share negative thoughts and feelings with friends
Feeling that 'if none of them understand, who will', experiencing isolation and estrangement
outcomes: Relationship tension and insufficient sense of support
Self-care ability declines (such as eating being affected)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Not fully sharing true negative thoughts and feelings with friends
Withdrawing the impulse to seek support outward and turning it into self-blame and internal friction

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Believing friends will not understand and may even judge one
Reducing help-seeking and expression accordingly, thus reinforcing the sense of isolation

positive_force: Strong love for mother put into continuous action (daily calls, communicating with the nurse, sending items within one's means)
Willing to try small steps and behavioral experiments
Has some rational reflection ability (can identify negative thoughts and discuss them with the counselor)
Has a few close friends who can provide potential support
negative_force: Self-labeling and personalizing tendencies (attributing the inability to visit entirely to one's own moral failure)
Mental filtering and negating positive evidence keep guilt going
Financial stress and real-life limits (unable to visit frequently)
Social avoidance and unwillingness to share fully lead to low support utilization
Self-care impaired (basic care such as eating is affected)

target_behavior.behavior: Continuously labeling myself a 'monster' and engaging in self-deprecation
antecedent: Thinking of mother being hospitalized and being unable to visit regularly due to financial difficulties
Facing situations requiring meeting mother's needs or recalling related details
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing the failure to meet idealized responsibilities as moral failure (personalization and black-and-white thinking), easing inner anxiety and guilt through self-punishment
target_behavior.function: Self-punishment to maintain a moral sense and sense of control, temporarily easing anxiety while consolidating the negative self-schema
target_behavior.consequence: Guilt and stress intensify, mental health is harmed, further weakening action and coping ability

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and unwillingness to fully share true feelings with friends
antecedent: When asked about or thinking of seeking support from friends
Subjectively feeling 'they do not understand' after talking with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about being judged and not understood (projection and mind reading), reducing potential hurt through avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible rejection or judgment to lower immediate anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Low utilization of the support system, rising interpersonal tension and loneliness

antecedent: When guilt and stress run high
Thinking of situations where mother's needs cannot be met
target_behavior.core_reason: High levels of guilt and self-criticism occupy cognitive resources, leading to reduced behavioral activation and basic self-care ability
target_behavior.function: Passively avoids stressors and emotional experiences (reduces emotional load in the short term)
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired physical health and daily functioning, further worsening negative emotions and helplessness
